steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('.phitex-marks .phitex-mark.error'); if (!m) return false; const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cm-line')].find((l) => l.textContent.includes('\\foobar')); if (!t) return 'no line'; const range = document.createRange(); const n = [...t.childNodes].flatMap((c) => c.nodeType === 3 ? [c] : [...c.childNodes].filter((x) => x.nodeType === 3)).find((x) => x.textContent.includes('\\foobar')); if (!n) return 'no text'; const i = n.textContent.indexOf('\\foobar'); range.setStart(n, i); range.setEnd(n, i + 7); const w = range.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs(r.left - w.left) < 3 && Math.abs(r.width - w.width) < 4 && r.top >= w.top && r.top <= w.bottom + 3; })()
